title: BrowserBot Workflow Spec Schema
description: Defines the schema for the Intermediate Representation (IR) of a parameterized browser workflow. Consumed by Phase 4 Code Generator.

schema_version.description: Version of the workflow spec schema. Fixed at '1.0' for backwards compatibility.

metadata.description: Metadata about the generation process and provenance.

generator_version.description: The version of BrowserBot that generated this spec.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this spec was generated.

source_session_id.description: The session ID of the Action Log from which this spec was derived.

workflow.description: High-level logical information about the workflow.

site.description: The primary domain name where the workflow occurs.

start_url.description: The initial URL loaded to start the workflow.

description.description: A clear, single-sentence description of the workflow's purpose.

steps.description: The ordered sequence of steps to execute the workflow. These are identical to Action Log steps but may include parameter mapping.

parameter_name.description: If this step is parameterised, this points to the name of the parameter in the parameters list.

parameters.description: The confirmed input parameters required to run this workflow.

fixed_step_indices.description: Indices of steps that remain structural and use static values.

outputs.description: Data extracted from the page during workflow execution.

example_value.description: The static value used in the recording, used as an example/default.

log_step_index.description: The step_index in the workflow steps where this parameter is bound.

is_sensitive.description: Whether this parameter contains credentials/secrets and should be redacted/masked.

is_optional.description: Whether this parameter is optional (e.g. falls back to blank or a default value if missing).

name.description: The output variable name in lowercase snake_case.

log_step_index.description: The step_index where this output is extracted.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this extracted text represents.
